workflow.name: TC-05c Long Input

data.label: Receive Order
data.rationale: Deterministic intake, deduplication, persistence, and event emission are rules-based system operations. The step is operational orchestration rather than AI/ML.
conditions: idempotency_key must be present or derivable
payload must be persisted before downstream fan-out
emit audit log and state-change event on success
data.description: Accept an inbound customer order, enforce idempotency, and emit diagnostic telemetry for auditing and downstream processing.
data.errorHandling: On duplicate order, short-circuit to idempotent success. On transient DB or queue failures, retry with exponential backoff and jitter up to bounded attempts. On partial persistence or telemetry failure, write a compensating audit record, notify operations, and route to manual review if consistency cannot be guaranteed.

data.label: Validate Payload
data.rationale: Schema and field validation are deterministic rule-based checks. No learning or language reasoning is needed.
conditions: required fields must be present
field types must match schema
PII fields must be redacted in logs
data.description: Check the order payload schema and basic required fields before any downstream operations proceed.
data.errorHandling: Reject malformed payloads immediately with a validation response. Persist the validation failure event, emit alerts for sustained error rates, and do not advance workflow state. Retry only for transient schema registry or dependency access failures.

data.label: Authenticate Customer
data.rationale: Authentication is deterministic token/session/policy verification with lookup-based checks. It does not require ML or language models.
conditions: customer session or token must validate
high-risk login patterns should trigger step-up review
failed auth attempts must be rate limited
data.description: Verify customer identity and gate the order for fraud and policy-sensitive handling.
data.errorHandling: On auth failure, deny progression and record security telemetry. On transient identity-provider failures, retry with bounded exponential backoff. If the identity confidence is ambiguous or step-up auth is required, route to manual review and notify operations.

data.label: Assess Fraud Risk
data.rationale: Fraud risk scoring is a supervised ML classification task. The workflow uses a trained model to produce a risk score, then deterministic routing applies threshold rules.
conditions: score threshold determines approve vs review
manual review required for high-value or ambiguous orders
risk features must be versioned
data.description: Check fraud risk scores and route high-risk or ambiguous orders to manual review when needed.
data.errorHandling: If the fraud scoring service times out or returns an invalid score, fail closed for high-value orders and route to manual review; fail open only when policy explicitly allows. Retries are bounded, and every exception is logged and surfaced to the operations team.

data.label: Prepare Pricing and Payment
data.rationale: Pricing, tax, shipping, discounting, and invoice generation are deterministic business rules and service integrations.
conditions: payment method must be on file before capture
promotions and loyalty rules must be applied in policy order
currency conversion must use locked FX rate for the order
data.description: Verify payment method availability, apply discounts and loyalty rewards, compute taxes and shipping, and generate the final invoice.
data.errorHandling: If any pricing dependency fails, retry transiently and preserve the last known good quote. On permanent tax or shipping rate failure, stop and flag for manual review. Emit a pricing discrepancy event if computed totals differ from expected thresholds.

data.label: Reserve and Allocate Inventory
data.rationale: Inventory reservation, allocation, and split logic are deterministic transactional operations over operational data.
conditions: inventory reservations must be atomic per line item
order may split across fulfillment centers
partial availability must trigger partial fulfillment path
data.description: Check warehouse availability, reserve inventory, split the order by fulfillment center, and create fulfillment allocations.
data.errorHandling: On reservation contention, retry with bounded backoff. If partial inventory exists, reserve available items and route the remainder to backorder/exception handling. If warehouse availability cannot be confirmed, release any holds and notify operations.

data.label: Charge Payment
data.rationale: Payment capture with idempotency, bounded retries, decline handling, and chargeback awareness is deterministic integration logic.
conditions: only run after invoice is finalized
use idempotency key per order capture attempt
route declines to decline-handling branch
data.description: Capture payment for the order and handle bounded retries and decline outcomes.
data.errorHandling: Retry transient gateway/network errors with exponential backoff and jitter. On payment decline, route to decline handling. On suspected duplicate capture or reversal, reconcile and alert finance and operations. If retry budget is exhausted, emit a failure event and hold fulfillment if not already shipped.

data.label: Send Order Confirmation
data.rationale: Customer-facing confirmation content benefits from language generation and templating; the send action itself remains deterministic.
conditions: confirmation is sent only after payment capture succeeds
fallback to templated static message if model generation fails
do not include sensitive payment details
data.description: Notify the customer by email and SMS that the order has been accepted and confirmed.
data.errorHandling: If notification delivery fails, retry via alternate channel and queue for later resend. If LLM generation fails, fall back to a approved static template. Persistent delivery failure must alert operations and be logged for customer support follow-up.

data.label: Fulfill Order
data.rationale: Warehouse and carrier orchestration is procedural system integration and state transition logic.
conditions: fulfillment work order requires inventory reservation and successful payment
labels must be generated before pickup scheduling
pickup scheduling depends on warehouse cutoff windows
data.description: Create the fulfillment work order, pick items, pack boxes, generate shipping labels, schedule carrier pickup, and hand off the shipment.
data.errorHandling: If pick/pack fails, requeue the affected work order and notify the warehouse. If label generation or pickup scheduling fails, retry transiently then escalate to operations. Partial shipment states must be persisted and reconciled before any subsequent shipping events.

data.label: Track Shipment
data.rationale: Shipment tracking and exception monitoring are deterministic polling/event-handling operations.
conditions: tracking starts after carrier handoff
delay notifications only on exception thresholds
tracking events must be deduplicated
data.description: Track shipment in transit, send tracking updates, monitor delivery exceptions, and notify the customer about delays.
data.errorHandling: Transient tracking API failures should retry with backoff. If a shipment exception or delay is detected, create an alert, notify the customer, and hand off to support/operations. Persistent carrier outages should be logged and monitored with escalation thresholds.

data.label: Confirm Delivery
data.rationale: Delivery confirmation is a deterministic state transition based on carrier proof-of-delivery events and fixed rules.
conditions: delivery confirmation requires proof-of-delivery or carrier completion event
customer review request should follow only successful delivery
failed confirmation should trigger exception monitoring
data.description: Confirm delivery on receipt, request customer review, and mark the shipment as complete.
data.errorHandling: If delivery cannot be confirmed, keep the shipment in transit state and continue polling. On carrier event inconsistency, open an exception case and notify operations. Retry carrier confirmation lookups with bounded backoff.

data.label: Post Financial Records
data.rationale: Accounting and reconciliation are deterministic workflows driven by fixed ledger rules and data mappings.
conditions: only post after delivery or approved shipment completion state
reconciliation must match captured payment amount
monthly metrics must aggregate by accounting period
data.description: Record the transaction in the general ledger, reconcile captured payment, post revenue, and update monthly sales metrics.
data.errorHandling: If ledger posting fails, retry with idempotency and preserve reconciliation state. Any mismatch between captured amount and posted revenue must create a finance exception and alert accounting. If analytics warehouse updates fail, queue a backfill job.

data.label: Update Operational Telemetry
data.rationale: The summary generation component is language generation, while the rest is deterministic telemetry and alerting. The presence of narrative management reporting raises this above pure automation.
conditions: run telemetry refresh after financial posting
forecasting should only trigger for low-stock SKUs
daily summary should be generated on schedule or on-demand
data.description: Refresh inventory telemetry, forecast restock for depleted SKUs, trigger supplier reorder, surface anomaly alerts, and generate a daily operations summary.
data.errorHandling: Telemetry and forecast jobs should retry transiently. If summary generation fails, fall back to a templated management report. Anomaly detection failures must be surfaced to operations and logged for later replay.

data.label: Handle Returns and Exceptions
data.rationale: Returns and exception handling are deterministic state transitions, inventory updates, refund calls, and templated notifications.
conditions: trigger on return request, payment decline, fraud escalation, or delivery exception
refunds only allowed for eligible return states
restock only for sellable condition
data.description: Process returns, generate return authorizations and prepaid labels, receive and inspect returned goods, restock or dispose items, issue refunds, update return ledgers, and notify the customer.
data.errorHandling: Each return substep retries independently with bounded backoff. If refund issuance fails, queue a compensating transaction and alert finance. If inspection or disposition cannot complete, hold the item in quarantine and notify operations. All exception paths must be audit logged.

data.label: Archive Order
data.rationale: Archival is deterministic persistence, retention, and lifecycle closure.
conditions: order can be archived only after terminal completion or terminal exception resolution
retention policy must be applied before object-store write
DSAR and audit access paths must reference archived record IDs
data.description: Close out the order lifecycle, persist long-term records, and archive the order for audit, reporting, and compliance retention.
data.errorHandling: Retry archival writes with backoff. If long-term storage fails, persist a retry marker and alert operations. Never delete the operational record until archival confirmation is durable and verifiable.

data.label: Human Review Gate: High Value / Ambiguous Order
data.rationale: High-value, ambiguous, or policy-sensitive e-commerce orders require human approval before financial capture and fulfillment proceed.
conditions: trigger when fraud score is near threshold
trigger when order value exceeds review threshold
trigger when customer identity confidence is ambiguous or step-up review is required
data.description: Pause workflow execution for manual approval or rejection before pricing finalization and payment capture.
data.errorHandling: If no reviewer responds within SLA, escalate to operations and keep order in pending-review state.

data.condition: summary generation failed but telemetry persistence succeeded

data.label: retry payment when allowed
data.condition: payment decline is retryable and retry budget remains

data.condition: manual review completed with terminal outcome or compensation recorded

workflow.workflowBrief:
We operate a high-volume e-commerce order fulfillment platform. Below is an exhaustive description of the end-to-end workflow that must run for every inbound order from submission through final archival. The process must handle happy path flows, payment declines, fraud flags, partial fulfillment, returns, chargebacks, and analytics reporting, with comprehensive logging, monitoring, human review gates for high-value transactions, and strict SLAs on each downstream integration point. The workflow is as follows:

Step 1: receive incoming customer order. This step is critical because it interacts with multiple downstream systems, must be idempotent, and must log full diagnostic telemetry for auditing. It may succeed, fail, or produce partial results that require manual review. Retries should be bounded and backed off, and failures should escalate to the operations team when necessary. Appropriate notifications must fire to the customer, the operations team, and internal analytics whenever state changes. Data must be persisted to long-term storage and indexed for reporting. Compliance, privacy, and security constraints must be enforced at every boundary.
